Patrick D. VanMeter, PhD

Core Focus Areas

Medical Imaging & Computer Vision

Designing and validating deep learning segmentation, denoising, and deconvolution pipelines for clinical ultrasound and high-resolution photon-counting CT imaging, from clinical data curation through FDA V&V testing.

Healthcare Analytics & ML

Building predictive models, interconnected procedural grouping pipelines, and NLP-inspired representation learning architectures over large-scale healthcare claims and clinical datasets.

Physics & Bayesian Inference

Developing quantitative forward models, custom X-ray instrumentation, and Bayesian Integrated Data Analysis (IDA) frameworks to infer physical parameters under uncertainty.
